payload.objective: Education Portal, 5 phases, each a reviewable PR into development, plan at C:\Users\ahmed\.claude\plans\use-rufle-agents-swarms-fuzzy-lighthouse-of-bbb93ad9-4df8-4945-b6b4-ae529f2bf0e3.md. Phase 1 rights foundation: per-campus role rights (RolePermission.CampusId), ViewHistory right, own-rights API and Angular RightsService with rights-aware menu and guard. Phase 2 Tenant table above School (one master tenant unique index, only the master domain adds schools, default modules on registration, module checks on every API and Angular route; ADR first). Phase 3 users and roles in one screen, role per campus rights matrix, multiple roles per user, create rule (modal for small entities, page for large), soft delete. Phase 4 readable change history (who, what, when) filtered and shown by permission. Phase 5 full-screen month calendar from Angular Material and theme, hide My children for non-parents. Follow AGENTS.md rules, tenant/campus/module denial tests, i18n en/ar/ur, Ruflo memory rule 11.
